01

“By the star when it descends”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 53:1).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
By the star when it descends [al-Najm 1] meaning: "the Pleiades, when it sets at dawn."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَالنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَى [النجم: 1] ، يَعْنِي: «الثُّرَيَّا، إِذَا سَقَطَ مَعَ الْفَجْرِ»
Edition record 373467 · p. 625Link to report ↗
02

“one of soundness [mirra]”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Abū Razīn (Q 53:6).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
one of soundness [mirra] [al-Najm 6] meaning: "possessor of strength, meaning Gabriel ﷺ."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
ذُو مِرَّةٍ [النجم: 6] ، يَعْنِي: «ذُو قُوَّةٍ، يَعْنِي جِبْرِيلَ عليه السلام»
Edition record 373468 · p. 625Link to report ↗
03
Report from Abū Razīn 03

Abū Razīn

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Shayban related to us, from Asim ibn Abi al-Najud, from Abu Razin, who said:
"The qab is the measure, and the qaws: He says: the measure of two cubits."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ أَبِي النَّجُودِ، عَنِ أَبِي رَزِينٍ، قَالَ:
" الْقَابُ: الْقَيْدُ، وَالْقَوْسُ: يَقُولُ: قَيْدُ ذِرَاعَيْنِ "
Edition record 373469 · p. 625Link to report ↗
03

“and was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 53:9).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer [al-Najm 9] meaning: "where the string is on the bow, meaning his Lord from Gabriel ﷺ."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَى [النجم: 9] يَعْنِي: «حَيْثُ الْوَتَرُ مِنَ الْقَوْسِ، يَعْنِي رَبَّهُ مِنْ جِبْرِيلَ عليه السلام»
Edition record 373470 · p. 625Link to report ↗
04

“The heart did not lie [about] what it saw”

Seven explanations transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās, Ibn Masʿūd, Musa ibn Salim and others (Q 53:11).

05
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 05

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: al-Mubarak ibn Fudala related to us, from Ali ibn Zayd ibn Judan, from Yusuf ibn Mihran, from Ibn Abbas:
The heart did not lie [about] what it saw [al-Najm 11] he said: "He saw his Lord, Mighty and Majestic, with his heart."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ:
مَا كَذَبَ الْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَى [النجم: 11] قَالَ: «رَأَى رَبَّهُ عز وجل بِفُؤَادِهِ»
Edition record 373471 · p. 625Link to report ↗
06
Report from Ibn Masʿūd 06

Ibn Masʿūd

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Israil related to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Yazid, from Ibn Masud, who said:
"The Messenger of God ﷺ saw Gabriel in a green cloak of rafraf, filling what is between the heaven and the earth."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ:
«رَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ جِبْرِيلَ فِي حُلَّةٍ رَفْرَفٍ أَخْضَرَ قَدْ مَلَأَ مَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ»
Edition record 373472 · p. 625Link to report ↗
07
Report from Musa ibn Salim 07

Musa ibn Salim

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ata ibn al-Sa'ib, from Musa ibn Salim, who said:
"The Messenger of God ﷺ saw Gabriel ﷺ in his [true] form only once; he saw him wearing green garments with pearls on them."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ سَالِمٍ، قَالَ:
«لَمْ يَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ جِبْرِيلَ عليه السلام فِي صُورَتِهِ إِلَّا مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً رَآهُ وَعَلَيْهِ ثِيَابٌ خُضْرٌ فِيهَا الدُّرُّ»
Edition record 373473 · p. 626Link to report ↗
08
Report from Murra al-Hamdānī 08

Murra al-Hamdānī

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Husayn ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Murra al-Hamdani, who said:
"Gabriel ﷺ came to the Messenger of God ﷺ in the form of an angel only twice; he came to him in green, hung with pearls."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ حُصَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ مُرَّةَ الْهَمَذَانِيِّ، قَالَ:
«مَا أَتَى جِبْرِيلُ عليه السلام رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي صُورَةِ الْمَلَائِكَةِ إِلَّا مَرَّتَيْنِ أَتَاهُ فِي خُضْرٍ مُعَلَّقٍ بِهِ الدُّرُّ»
Edition record 373474 · p. 626Link to report ↗
09
Report from Ibn Masʿūd 09

Ibn Masʿūd

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, from Asim ibn Abi al-Najud, from Zirr ibn Hubaysh, from Ibn Masud, who said:
The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "I saw Gabriel ﷺ; he has six hundred wings, from whose feathers scatter marvels, pearls and rubies."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ أَبِي النَّجُودِ، عَنْ زِرِّ بْنِ حُبَيْشٍ، عَنْ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ:
«رَأَيْتُ جِبْرِيلَ عليه السلام، لَهُ سِتُّمِائَةِ جَنَاحٍ يَتَنَاثَرُ مِنْ رِيشِهِ التَّهَاوِيلُ الدُّرُّ وَالْيَاقُوتُ»
Edition record 373475 · p. 626Link to report ↗
10
Report from ʿĀʾisha 10

ʿĀʾisha

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: al-Mubarak ibn Fudala related to us, from Hisham ibn Urwa, from his father, from Aisha, who said:
"Whoever claims that Muhammad ﷺ saw his Lord, Mighty and Majestic, has lied."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ:
«مَنْ زَعَمَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا ﷺ رَأَى رَبَّهُ عز وجل فَقَدْ كَذَبَ»
Edition record 373476 · p. 626Link to report ↗
11
Report from Anas ibn Mālik 11

Anas ibn Mālik

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Shayban related to us, saying: Qatada related to us, from Anas ibn Malik, who said:
The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "When I was taken up to the heaven, I was raised to the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary, and I saw a great light beside it. Its leaves were like the ears of elephants and its fruit like the jars of Hajar. And there were four rivers: two outward and two inward flowed from its base. ⦗p. 627⦘ I said: 'What is this, O Gabriel?' He said: 'As for the two inward ones, they are two rivers in Paradise; as for the two outward ones, they are the Nile and the Euphrates.'"
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا شَيْبَانُ، قَالَ: نا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ:
" لَمَّا عُرِجَ بِي إِلَى السَّمَاءِ رُفِعْتُ إِلَى سِدْرَةِ الْمُنْتَهَى، فَرَأَيْتُ عِنْدَهَا نُورًا عَظِيمًا، وَإِذَا وَرَقُهَا مِثْلُ آذَانِ الْفُيُولِ، وَإِذَا نَبْقُهَا مِثْلُ قِلَالِ هَجَرَ، وَإِذَا أَرْبَعَةُ أَنْهَارٍ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَصْلِهَا نَهَرَانِ ظَاهِرَانِ وَنَهْرَانِ بَاطِنَانِ ⦗ص: 627⦘ فَقُلْتُ: مَا هَذَا يَا جِبْرِيلُ؟ قَالَ: أَمَا الْبَاطِنَانِ فَنَهَرَانِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ، وَأَمَّا الظَّاهِرَانِ فَالنِّيلُ وَالْفُرَاتُ "
Edition record 373477 · p. 626Link to report ↗
05

“when there covered the Lote Tree that which covered”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 53:16).

12
Explanation from Mujāhid 12

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
when there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [al-Najm 16] he said: "It was as if the branches of the Lote Tree were of pearl, ruby, and chrysolite, and Muhammad ﷺ saw it with his heart."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
إِذْ يَغْشَى السِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَى [النجم: 16] قَالَ: " كَأَنَّ أَغْصَانَ السِّدْرَةِ مِنْ لُؤْلُؤٍ وَيَاقُوتٍ وَزَبَرْجَدٍ فَرَآهَا مُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ بِقَلْبِهِ
Edition record 373478 · p. 627Link to report ↗
06

“an unjust division [dizi]”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 53:22).

13
Explanation from Mujāhid 13

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
an unjust division [dizi] [al-Najm 22] he said: "crooked."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَى [النجم: 22] قَالَ: «عَوْجَاءُ»
Edition record 373479 · p. 627Link to report ↗
07

“That is their sum of knowledge”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and al-Ḥasan (Q 53:30).

14
Explanation from Mujāhid 14

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
That is their sum of knowledge [al-Najm 30] meaning: "the extent of their opinion."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
ذَلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ [النجم: 30] ، يَعْنِي: «مَبْلَغَ رَأْيِهِمْ»
Edition record 373480 · p. 627Link to report ↗
15
Report from al-Ḥasan 15

al-Ḥasan

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Uqba al-Asamm related to us, saying: I heard al-Hasan say:
"The lamam is the passing thought of fornication, and the passing thought of drinking wine, and then he repents."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ الْأَصَمُّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ، يَقُولُ:
«اللَّمَمُ الْخَطْرَةُ مِنَ الزِّنَا، وَالْخَطْرَةُ مِنْ شُرْبِ الْخَمْرِ، ثُمَّ يَتُوبُ»
Edition record 373481 · p. 627Link to report ↗
08

“He is most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 53:32).

16
Explanation from Mujāhid 16

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
He is most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth [al-Najm 32] he said: It is like His words and He is most knowing of those who are guided [al-Qalam 7].
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنْشَأَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ [النجم: 32] قَالَ: هُوَ كَقَوْلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ [القلم: 7]
Edition record 373482 · p. 628Link to report ↗
09

“and gave a little and then stopped [akda]”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 53:34).

17
Explanation from Mujāhid 17

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and gave a little and then stopped [akda] [al-Najm 34] meaning: "al-Walid ibn al-Mughira gave a little and then stopped; He says: he cut off his giving."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَأَعْطَى قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَى [النجم: 34] ، يَعْنِي: " الْوَلِيدَ بْنَ الْمُغِيرَةِ أَعْطَى قَلِيلًا، ثُمَّ أَكْدَى يَقُولُ: قَطَعَ عَطَاءَهُ "
Edition record 373483 · p. 628Link to report ↗
10

“and Abraham, who fulfilled [his duty]”

An explanation transmitted from Abū Umāma (Q 53:37).

18
Explanation from Abū Umāma 18

Abū Umāma

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, saying: Jafar related to us, from al-Qasim, from Abu Umama, who said:
The Messenger of God ﷺ recited the verse and Abraham, who fulfilled [his duty] [al-Najm 37] and said: "Do you know what 'fulfilled' means?" We said: "God and His Messenger know best." He said: "He fulfilled by doing his day's work with four rakas at the start of the day." And Mujahid said: He says: "Fulfilled: what was made obligatory upon him."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرٌ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ، قَالَ: تَلَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْآيَةَ
وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ الَّذِي وَفَّى [النجم: 37] قَالَ: «أَتَدْرُونَ مَا وَفَّى؟» فَقُلْنَا: اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ، قَالَ: " وَفَّى: عَمِلَ يَوْمَهُ بِأَرْبَعِ رَكَعَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ ". أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ: يَقُولُ: " وَفَى: مَا فُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ "
